concerns.text: FR-009 requires computation of Mean Squared Error (MSE) quantization error on a subset of activations, but no task explicitly records or validates this MSE measurement (e.g., a task to compute and store activation‑level MSE).

FR-010 mandates a paired t‑test on variance differences between entropy‑matched prompt pairs; the task list only includes independent two‑sample tests (T004/T005) and lacks any task performing the required paired t‑test.
FR-011 calls for Spearman correlation between activation variance and MSE quantization error, yet no task is defined to compute this correlation or to produce the corresponding report.

FR-012 expects a demonstration that the router‑selected rotation matrix reduces MSE quantization error relative to the static baseline; there is no dedicated task that measures per‑prompt MSE reduction and validates the improvement.
SC-001 specifies a paired t‑test on variance differences; the current tasks (T004, T005) only perform independent two‑sample tests, leaving the success criterion untestable.
The implementation plan defines a Phase 0 for correlation and sensitivity study, but the tasks document starts at Phase 1 and contains no tasks covering Phase 0 activities.

SC-002 requires measurement of quantization error reduction (MSE, FID, CLIP) against the static baseline; while T011 computes MSE, it does not explicitly link the reduction to the router selection per prompt, nor does it reference the subset required by FR‑009.
